Gemini review: Agree on targeted pruning; reject any implied causal link between instruction size, token use and substitution. Causes remain unisolated, and synthetic replay cannot establish real delivery.
Next: Scope one documentation repair preserving pre-existing dirty work; independently inspect its diff; run a bounded representative skills-only task with a predeclared command budget, comparing redundant reads and unchanged acceptance evidence against baseline.
Risk: Stop expansion if the check substitutes the goal, weakens evidence, exceeds budget or fails to reduce redundant reads; even a pass supports only this scoped repair.
